title: Two-stage rounding, detailed final results sheet, and branded opening screen for Class V Assessment System

requirements.text: Fix marks persistence so that each mark for a given (studentId, subject, assessmentType) is stored as a single updatable record (overwrite on re-save) and remains saved across page refreshes and canister upgrades unless the user explicitly edits and saves again.

quotes: After I enter one student mark and Save mark the system not working properly i want to change to once I save the mark, the mark save forever still a user didn't edit it

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting marks for the same (studentId, subject, assessmentType) multiple times results in exactly one stored value (the latest) returned by getRawMarks.
After refreshing the browser, previously saved marks still load into the marks entry table.
After a canister upgrade/redeploy, previously saved marks are still available (stable storage).

requirements.text: Update backend final mark calculation to apply two-stage rounding (round up/ceiling) exactly as follows: (1) compute the weighted mark for the combined component FA1+FA2+SA1, then round up to a whole number; (2) compute the weighted mark for SA2, then round up to a whole number; then add these rounded components (plus written work and project work weighted components) to produce the final subject total.

quotes: Round up the mark two time before calculating the final Mark. 1st round of is do after calculating the waitage of FA1+ FA2+SA1 and the second Round up do after calculating the waitage of SA2 then add all mark and so the final results Sheet.

acceptanceCriteria: The FA1+FA2+SA1 weighted component is rounded up before it is added to the final subject total.
The SA2 weighted component is rounded up before it is added to the final subject total.
Final subject total equals the sum of the rounded FA component + rounded SA2 component + written work weighted component + project work weighted component.
No fractional/decimal values are exposed to the frontend; all returned totals are whole numbers.

requirements.text: Provide backend APIs and types to support a detailed "Final Results Sheet" view that includes, per student and per subject, all raw marks (FA1, FA2, SA1, SA2, Written Work, Project Work) and the corresponding weighted marks (weightage marks), along with the final subject total and grand total.

quotes: In the final results Sheet show the students all FA1, FA2, Sa1, SA2, written work and project work mark and the waitage mark also.

acceptanceCriteria: A backend query exists to fetch a per-student per-subject breakdown containing raw marks for FA1, FA2, SA1, SA2, Written Work (best-of-two), Project Work (best-of-two) and their computed weighted/weightage marks, plus the final subject total.
A backend query exists to fetch a session-wide results sheet for all students with the same per-subject breakdown and each student’s grand total.
The existing results queries continue to work (or are updated consistently) and reflect the new two-stage rounding rules.

requirements.text: Implement a frontend "Final Results Sheet" screen that displays (for the selected session) a table for all students showing each student’s marks: FA1, FA2, SA1, SA2, Written Work, Project Work, plus the weightage marks and final totals as provided by the backend.

quotes: In the final results Sheet show the students all FA1, FA2, Sa1, SA2, written work and project work mark and the waitage mark also.

acceptanceCriteria: The session results UI no longer shows placeholder dashes due to missing per-subject marks; it renders the detailed data returned by the backend.
For each student, the screen shows raw marks and weightage marks for FA1, FA2, SA1, SA2, Written Work, and Project Work, and also shows final subject totals and a grand total.
All user-facing labels are in English (e.g., “Final Results Sheet”, “Weightage”, “Written Work”, “Project Work”).

requirements.text: Add an opening window/splash/landing view shown first when the app is opened that displays exactly: "Class V Assessment System By Ratnakara Ranbida" (English text).

quotes: When the app is open show one window first Class V Assessment System By Ratnakara Ranbida

acceptanceCriteria: On initial app load, the first view shown contains the exact text: "Class V Assessment System By Ratnakara Ranbida".
The opening view transitions into the normal app flow without breaking authentication or navigation.

requirements.text: Update any frontend explanatory text about the calculation method to match the implemented two-stage rounding behavior and the backend’s current weightage rules.

quotes: Round up the mark two time before calculating the final Mark...

acceptanceCriteria: The "Calculation Method" section (and any similar help text) describes the two-stage rounding for FA1+FA2+SA1 and SA2 and does not contradict backend computation.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if required for stable-state upgrades.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose them instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Add external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
